responsibility: This file is the top-level selftest driver for GCC in checking builds. It defines selftest::run_tests, sets up the path to testsuite/selftests, constructs the test_runner, and then invokes the many per-subsystem test entry points in dependency order across common data structures, IR utilities, diagnostics, target hooks, language hooks, and analyzer tests before forcing a final GC. Its responsibility is central orchestration of embedded selftests, separate from the generic selftest framework in selftest.c.
